title: Distributed Inference with llm-d: priority-based flow control

steps.caption: llm-d deployed in the project: LLMInferenceService maas-llmd-demo — router, scheduler, gateway, and InferencePool are Ready; the model workload itself stays Pending on this CPU-only cluster

details.label: Module 01 Exercise 1
details.value: Inspect your llm-d deployment and the Endpoint Picker

steps.caption: The Endpoint Picker pod (router-scheduler) is Running with the default four-scorer scheduler configuration — no flow control configuration yet

details.label: Flow control
details.value: not enabled — enabled via the flowControl feature gate

steps.caption: Enabling the flowControl feature gate and a utilization-based saturation detector in the inline EndpointPickerConfig under spec.router.scheduler (Module 01 Exercise 2)

details.label: Save
details.value: the llm-d controller rolls the EPP with the new configuration

steps.caption: The EPP pod rolls to the new configuration — the old pod drains (Terminating) while the controller deploys the flowControl configuration; the replacement pod starts with flow control active

details.label: Rolling update
details.value: old EPP pod Terminating, replacement starting

steps.caption: The critical tier for interactive workloads: InferenceObjective interactive-critical with priority 100 — higher-priority requests dispatch before lower-priority bands
The sheddable batch tier: batch-workload with priority -1 — queued last and the first to be dropped when the pool reaches saturation, protecting real-time SLOs
Both priority tiers registered against the InferencePool — the flow control layer matches requests by objective and dispatches with strict priority ordering plus intra-band fairness

details.label: Enforcement
details.value: strict priority ordering + fairness policies within a band

steps.caption: The flow control metric is live: llm_d_epp_flow_control_pool_saturation scraped from the EPP. 1.0 is the gating set point — with no inference traffic on this CPU-only cluster the pool reads at the threshold rather than a live load level

details.label: Value
details.value: 1.0 — the gating set point where dispatch halts

details.label: Under load on a GPU cluster
details.value: values above 1.0 indicate oversubscription past the gating threshold

steps.caption: The LLM Performance dashboard — TTFT, E2E and inter-token latency percentiles plus KV cache hit rate and usage: the SLO panels that priority-based flow control protects under load
